apps.localizedDescription: Opt-in unsigned Jarvis prerelease for SideStore. Requires iOS 26 or later. This uses the same app identity as Asterion Veyra and may update an existing installation; it is not a separate sandboxed app. Export important chats and notes first, keep the existing app installed, and use the same signing account. Physical-device signing, voice/background behavior and retained-data upgrades are not verified. Generative chat requires supported Apple Intelligence hardware, enabled Apple Intelligence and downloaded OS model assets. The stable SideStore sources remain unchanged.

versions.localizedDescription: Jarvis 0.4.0 build 13 unsigned preview. Full automated native/companion verification passed. Physical iPhone/SideStore installation and data retention remain unverified. Export important data before updating.
